Tallinn, Estonia,New Year

📍 Singapore, Singapore 📅 January 01, 2026 📖 2 min read
Tags: Travel
Contents

Day 1

Now obviously I didnt expect anything to be open so I got canned food ready, the two area I visited was firstly was the Nun Tower and Walls for a nice view, after that I visited a Cookie exhibition where they make art using cookies. Finally I head to the Tallinn TV Tower to have a overview of the city, the view was nice ven if it was really cold.

Day 2

For day 2 I went to the open air museum and honestly it looks a little simillar to the one in Riga. I did fell down when heading down the beach, now with the ocean frozen. It kinda hurts through the takeaway is probably do more research. The one segment that is unique to this one is the Soviet block, I enjoyed the exhibitons as they tell us how is life in each house. It felt like it as left as it instead of a curated museum piece, with an audio on how are people life here. Now since I am writing almost 8 months since then I dont remember much, but I need to come here again. Before i left I also got some old buttons, it is quite nice. I got a Soviet Currency as well.

Day 3

Today is the day I go to Finland, I think I was suffering from travel fatique. I enjoyed the outside bar, well the bar is closed but it means I get to sleep there. The nice weather makes it comfortable to sleep in
